question: A _______ is a passive two-terminal electrical component that implements electrical resistance as a circuit element.
solution:
The correct answer is **resistor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** A resistor is a passive two-terminal electrical component that implements electrical resistance as a circuit element.**
 
• The resistor is a passive electrical component that** creates resistance in the flow of electric current.**
 
• In almost all electrical networks and electronic circuits, they can be found.
 
• The resistance is** measured in ohms (Ω).**
 
• An ohm is a resistance that occurs when a current of one ampere (A) passes through a resistor with a one-volt (V) drop across its terminals.
 
• The current is proportional to the voltage across the terminal ends.
